findings.title: POST /waterings returns 500 for an oversized bed_id
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (SQLite integer overflow in ensure_bed_exists)
findings.evidence: curl returned 'Internal Server Error' with status 500

findings.title: GET /waterings?bed_id and DELETE /waterings/{id} return 500 for oversized ids
findings.steps: GET /api/waterings?bed_id=99999999999999999999999; DELETE /api/waterings/99999999999999999999999. Opening /waterings?bed=99999999999999999999999 in the web app hits the same path
findings.evidence: Both curl calls returned 500 'Internal Server Error'

findings.title: Litres value of 1e400 (infinity) causes a 500
findings.evidence: curl status 500. Probably the 422 body can't be serialised because the rejected input is inf

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted and shown as '0 L'
findings.where: Beds page 'Record past watering' form; dashboard; waterings page
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.001 (the form uses novalidate and only checks > 0), or POST litres 0.0000001
findings.expected: Refused with a reason (the form min is 0.1), or shown accurately
findings.actual: Saved and shown as '0 L' on the dashboard and in the list; the success notice says 'Recorded 0 L'
findings.evidence: The dashboard SSR HTML showed 'North bed 0 L' for the watering with litres 1e-7

findings.title: Waterings page and dashboard error states have no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings fail (server down or 5xx), then open /waterings or the dashboard
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that refetches without a reload
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown, with no retry control. The dashboard doesn't even destructure refresh for waterings. The user has to reload the page
findings.evidence: Code: waterings.vue shows only an AlertMessage for wateringsError; index.vue only takes data and error from wateringsResult

findings.title: Bed list failure on the waterings page is silent, so the filter is empty
findings.steps: Make GET /api/beds fail while GET /api/waterings succeeds, then open /waterings
findings.expected: An error saying beds couldn't be loaded, with a retry
findings.actual: The error from bedsResult is ignored. The dropdown only offers 'All beds' and nothing says why
findings.evidence: Code: const { data: beds } = bedsResult; the error is never used

findings.title: An invalid bed query shows a raw technical error
findings.steps: Open /waterings?bed=abc (or a link to a deleted bed id)
findings.expected: A friendly message or a fallback to all beds; the select should match the filter in use
findings.actual: The page shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'. The select shows no matching option, there is no retry, and Clear filter is the only way out
findings.evidence: SSR HTML contained that alert text

findings.title: Bed filter isn't synced when the URL query changes on the same page
findings.steps: Open /waterings?bed=1, then click the 'Waterings' nav link (to /waterings) or use the browser Back button
findings.expected: The filter resets to match the URL
findings.actual: bedFilter is read from route.query only once, at setup, and never watched. The URL changes but the list stays filtered
findings.evidence: Code: bedFilter = ref(route.query.bed...) with no watch on route.query

findings.title: Requests have no 10 s timeout
findings.where: Beds page Water now / Save watering, waterings page delete and list, dashboard
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never answer), then click 'Water now'
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s with a visible error and the button is re-enabled
findings.actual: useApiClient/useApiFetch set no timeout, so the button stays 'Watering…'/disabled and loading text stays up indefinitely
findings.evidence: Code: $fetch.create in composables/useApi.ts has no timeout; the new calls use it as is

findings.title: Retrying a watering after a timeout or lost response creates a duplicate
findings.steps: Click Water now; the server records it but the response is lost or times out; click again
findings.actual: No idempotency key or dedupe, so each POST inserts a new row

findings.title: Concurrent waterings on two beds share one busy flag, so a double submit is possible
findings.steps: Click Water now on bed A, then quickly on bed B (slow network). When A finishes, click B again
findings.expected: B's button stays disabled until B's request finishes
findings.actual: wateringBedId is a single value: it switches to B, and when A finishes it is reset to null, re-enabling B while its request is still in flight. A second click records a duplicate
findings.evidence: Code: recordWatering's finally sets wateringBedId.value = null whichever request finishes

findings.title: Deleting an already-deleted watering shows an error, not success
findings.steps: Delete a watering in two tabs, or retry after a timeout
findings.expected: The second delete is treated as done (idempotent) and the list refreshes
findings.actual: The API returns 404 'Watering not found.', which is shown as an error, and the stale row stays until a refresh

findings.title: Past watering 'today' can be refused because the client and server time zones differ
findings.steps: Use a browser whose local date is ahead of the server's (e.g. UTC+13 in the evening, server UTC/CET) and save with the default date (todayIso)
findings.actual: The server checks date.today() in its own time zone and returns 'Watering date cannot be in the future.' Also, 'Water now' stores watered_on as the server's local date but watered_at in UTC
findings.evidence: Code: todayIso uses the browser time zone; not_in_future uses the server's date.today()

findings.title: Any ancient date is accepted (e.g. year 0001)
findings.steps: POST watered_on 0001-01-01 or type it in the date field
findings.expected: Implausible dates refused with a reason

findings.title: Long unbroken bed names can overflow the waterings tables at 375 px
findings.steps: Create a bed with a 60-character name with no spaces, water it, and view /waterings at 375 px
findings.expected: The name wraps; no sideways scroll
findings.actual: Table cells have no overflow-wrap/word-break and the table has no scroll wrapper, so it widens past the viewport
findings.evidence: CSS: .table td has no overflow-wrap; no global overflow-wrap rule in main.css

findings.title: 'Water now' timestamps are formatted in the SSR server's time zone, so they can mismatch on hydration
findings.steps: View the pages in a browser whose time zone differs from the Nuxt server's
findings.actual: formatDateTime has no fixed timeZone, so the SSR text uses the server zone and the client zone differs, causing a hydration mismatch or wrong time on first paint
findings.evidence: Code: dateTimeFormatter has no timeZone option
